name: Lake Bronson State Park, Two Rivers Campground
waterfront_evidence: ReserveMN facility 842 search/details for all 96 units (night of 2027-08-15, read 2026-11-11): no unit carries the 'Water Front' amenity (it is set on seven Lakeside units in the same park), 94 units say 'Lake/River/Creek: .3 mile'. Esri World_Imagery 2026-11-11 at 48.7255,-96.6035 (660 m frame) with every unit's ReserveMN map point plotted: all 96 sites sit in continuous mixed woods; the nearest water, the Two Rivers channel and the lake arm to the S and SE, lies ~130-170 m from the outermost sites (105, 148, 188) through forest. No site within 50 m of water and no sightline through the canopy -> not waterfront.
inclusion_evidence: MN DNR Lake Bronson record spk00208 (read 2026-11-11): 'The Two Rivers Campground will remain open during the construction project'; 'There are 12 electric sites in this campground. The road to the campground, as well as the campground loop roads are narrow. Not meant for large rigs.'; 'Sites at Two Rivers Campground offer 30 amp service'; RV length limit 50 ft. DNR park map (2025) shows Two Rivers on its own road ~1.5 km east of Lakeside with its own shower building. ReserveMN PlaceId 125, facility 842 'Two Rivers Campground Not accessible to large RV's': 96 web-bookable back-in units (82 Drive-In $24, 12 Drive-In Electric 30 A $34, 2 equestrian $24), pads 30-60 ft (only four at 30 ft), 2027 season 05-14..10-24. A real public drive-in RV campground a 23-ft rig fits.
note: Lake Bronson State Park's wooded campground, about 1.5 km east of the Lakeside loops, which have their own entry. The DNR calls the access road and the loop roads narrow and 'not meant for large rigs'. The park's dump station is by the park office near Lakeside. --Claude

sites.note: All back-in: 82 non-electric, 12 with 30-amp electric and two equestrian sites. ReserveMN pads run 30-60 ft.

fees.note: ReserveMN: drive-in site $24 a night, electric $34.
